notablePrerequisites:
Pili-Pala exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
Magus Lucea Kane has at least one +1/+1 counter on it, and does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Magus Lucea Kane by tapping it, adding {C}{C} and copying the next spell you cast or ability you activate with {X} in its mana cost.
